Third-party code served from this site, so visitors' browsers never contact a
CDN (unpkg.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net) for it. Each file is byte-identical to the
published npm release; to upgrade, add a new versioned folder and change the
references, never edit a file in place (the pages pin Leaflet by SRI hash).
